skill.name: Plugin Settings
skill.description: Guides plugin authors through storing per-project Claude Code plugin settings in .claude/*.local.md files with YAML frontmatter and markdown context.
skill.summary: Use local markdown settings files to configure Claude Code plugins per project.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, and local Bash examples for parsing .claude/*.local.md files. The executable scripts only read user-selected local settings files or validate hook input, and the high filesystem and sensitive matches are defensive deny checks. No prompt injection text, network access, credential exfiltration, or malicious persistence intent was found.

remediation.issue: Settings body content can influence agent behavior when used as a prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Document that markdown body content must come from trusted local users before hooks feed it back to Claude Code.

remediation.issue: Examples rely on grep and sed for YAML-like parsing.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend yq or a dedicated parser when settings include nested YAML, lists, or special characters.

remediation.issue: Utility scripts accept a file path from the caller.
remediation.suggestion: When adapting the scripts, restrict accepted paths to the intended .claude/*.local.md settings files.

content.value_statement: Plugin authors need a simple way to store project-specific settings without committing private state. This skill explains a local markdown settings pattern with validation, parsing, and hook integration.
actual_capabilities: Shows YAML frontmatter fields and markdown body usage.
Provides Bash examples for hooks, commands, and agents.
Includes parser and validator scripts for local settings files.
Documents validation, gitignore, permissions, and restart guidance.
limitations: Focuses on simple YAML fields and may need yq for complex structures.

best_practices: Keep settings under .claude/ with a .local.md suffix and gitignore them.
Validate frontmatter values before using them in hooks or commands.
Treat markdown body content as trusted local input before feeding it to an agent.

Reading freeform settings body content from untrusted project files without review.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps plugin authors store per-project settings without changing plugin source files.

faq.question: Where are settings stored?
faq.answer: The pattern stores settings in .claude/plugin-name.local.md inside the project directory.

faq.question: Why use YAML frontmatter?
faq.answer: Frontmatter keeps structured settings easy to parse while leaving room for markdown context.

faq.question: Can hooks read these settings?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows hook examples that parse local settings before applying behavior.

faq.question: Should these files be committed?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends gitignore rules because these files can contain user-local state.

faq.question: Does it handle complex YAML?
faq.answer: It covers simple fields and recommends yq when lists or nested structures need reliable parsing.
